credential_controller: The authorized child proof obtains a new operator and a new viewer JWT from the governed dev-login endpoint immediately before its credentialed phase.
Only dev-login client credentials remain in Actions secrets; issued bearer JWTs are masked and passed to subsequent proof steps through GITHUB_ENV without being persisted in the repository.
The preflight rejects missing, malformed, expired, insufficient-lifetime, stale-issued, future-issued, and shared-subject JWTs before the first proof write.
watchdog_restore: The independent watchdog pins frontend and backend compatibility refs to the authorized candidate and BFF SHAs before its restore compatibility gate.
A later frontend or backend dev-tip advance therefore cannot redirect or block the exact-pair read-only restore.
The watchdog still quiesces a failed or timed-out child before it invokes the existing paired safe-sibling restore controller.
not_changed: Product feature behavior and BFF runtime contracts.
Read-only default deployment profile, pair identity checks, and the existing watchdog restore transaction.
Live Actions secret values, hosted proof dispatch, and any capital-affecting operation.
